cloudLoggingSeverity.description: Optional. Severity selected by the customer for the logs to be sent to Cloud Logging, for the integration version getting executed.
enumDescriptions: If Severity selected is `INFO`, then all the Integration Execution States (`IN_PROCESS`, `ON_HOLD`, `SUCCEEDED`, `SUSPENDED`, `ERROR`, `CANCELLED`) will be sent to Cloud Logging.
If Severity selected is `ERROR`, then only the following Integration Execution States (`ERROR`, `CANCELLED`) will be sent to Cloud Logging.
If Severity selected is `WARNING`, then only the following Integration Execution States (`ERROR`, `CANCELLED`) will be sent to Cloud Logging.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2CloudLoggingDet.description: Cloud Logging details for execution info

httpCode.description: The http code of the task response.

errorMessage.description: The error message of the task response in case of failure.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetGenerateJav.description: Response message containing generated Javascript code recommendations.

expireAfterMs.description: Milliseconds after which the suspension expires, if no action taken.

liftWhenExpired.description: Whether the suspension will be REJECTED or LIFTED upon expiration. REJECTED is the default behavior.

remindAfterMs.description: Milliseconds after which the previous suspension action reminder, if any, is sent using the selected notification option, for a suspension which is still PENDING_UNSPECIFIED.

startTime.description: The start time of the execution for the current attempt. This could be in the future if it's been scheduled.

endTime.description: The end time of the execution for the current attempt.

EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoFieldMappingCo.description: Field Mapping Config to map multiple output fields values from input fields values.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetGenerateInt.description: Request message for generating documentation for an integration version.

integrationDocumentRequest.description: Required. The integration document request payload.

integrationVersion.description: Required. The current integrtion on the canvas.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetIntegration.description: The request for generating description of an integration.

keyType.description: Option to specify key value type for all entries of the map. If provided then field types for all entries must conform to this.

EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoParameterMap.description: A generic multi-map that holds key value pairs. They keys and values can be of any type, unless specified.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetEventParame.description: This message is used for processing and persisting (when applicable) key value pair parameters for each event in the event bus.

key.description: Key is used to retrieve the corresponding parameter value. This should be unique for a given fired event. These parameters must be predefined in the integration definition.

value.description: Values for the defined keys. Each value can either be string, int, double or any proto message.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetIntParamete.description: This message only contains a field of integer array.

errorMsg.description: Add the error message when loops fail.

currentIterationDetail.description: Needs to be set by the loop impl class before each iteration. The abstract loop class will append the request and response to it. Eg. The foreach Loop will clean up and set it as the current iteration element at the start of each loop. The post request and response will be appended to the value once they are available.

failureLocation.description: Indicates where in the loop logic did it error out.
enumDescriptions: Setting for loop current element failed.

additionalProperties.description: Properties of the object. Contains field @type with type URL.

taskNumber.description: Pointer to the task config it used for execution.

taskExecutionState.description: Output only. The execution state of this task.
enumDescriptions: Task execution successfully finished. There are no more changes after this state.
Task execution failed. There's no more change after this state.
Task execution failed and cause the whole integration execution to fail immediately. There's no more change after this state.
Task execution failed and is waiting for retry.
Task execution cancelled when in progress. This happens when integration execution was cancelled or any other task fell into a fatal state.
Task is a SuspensionTask which has executed once, creating a pending suspension.

taskAttemptStats.description: List for the current task execution attempts.
